bead.title: Implement sqlite relational typed secondary indexes
bead.description: Implement ADR-011 typed secondary index parity for sqlite relational storage, which currently returns EngineError::Unavailable for index reads. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs, sqlite migrations/schema helpers, sqlite tests/conformance. Add pqueue_item_indexes or equivalent schema storing canonical axon_esf index_key bytes plus enough metadata for unique/non-unique lookup. Maintain rows on push, replace_pending, update_fields, purge, and replay/open. Enforce unique conflicts before durable mutation. Preserve schema-less queues and queues with no indexes. Out-of-scope: postgres implementation.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite relational_conformance -- --nocapture passes; cargo test -p pqueue-conformance index_conformance --features sqlite -- --nocapture passes if such feature exists, otherwise add/run the project-appropriate sqlite index conformance command; tests prove sqlite no longer returns Unavailable for typed index query, unique conflicts are atomic, and reopen/replay rebuilds index rows.
